storage_surfaces.source: // Accessing localStorage itself can throw when browser storage is disabled.
const storage = { getItem: key => localStorage.getItem(key), setItem: (key, value) => localStorage.setItem(key, value) };
try { storage = window.localStorage; } catch { /* Worksheet reports unavailable saving. */ }
this.storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ rows: this.rows, active: this.active, variables: this.variables }));
try { storage = window.localStorage; } catch { /* Calculation still works without storage. */ }
try { saved = JSON.parse(storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)); } catch { /* Start empty if storage is unavailable. */ }
try { storage = window.localStorage; } catch { /* Editing remains available. */ }
try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, serializeWorksheet(expressions, activeIndex, variables)); } catch { /* The calculator still works for this session. */ }
try { return globalThis.localStorage; } catch { return null; }
